rationale: Real-world high-risk AI testing explicitly prevents reversing or disregarding decisions; this duty is separate from requested erasure.
The targeted reversal and disregard safeguards are enabled; an isolated excerpt does not establish that all other protections are missing.
Machine-readable digital marking with explicitly no notified body does not require that body's number.
The notified body participated and its required identification number is missing.
A self-reported preference record does not establish AI training or inference; other privacy law is outside this test.
Training a high-risk medical triage model explicitly bypasses dataset representativeness requirements.
